name: realm-file

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them, with `ajv` and `ajv-formats` added, which validate the fixtures against the published JSON Schema. The tests also read files elsewhere: the published schema apps/docs-site/public/schemas/realm-file-v1-rc.0.json, which `realm-file:schema-export` writes, and the stable-surface registry that names it are compared with what the schema generates, and the seed manifests the repository ships (graphs/fixtures/seed-manifest.json, apps/wire-suite/seed/clients.json) must parse as realm files. Without these entries a change to one of those files would replay a cached pass.

schema-export.description: Write apps/docs-site/public/schemas/realm-file-v1-rc.0.json, the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the declarative realm file urn:qauth:realm-file:v1-rc.0 (ADR-018 §5, #515), from the Zod schema in src/lib/realm-file.ts. The stable-surface check runs it, fails on drift, and compares the file with the latest release as an input document.
